text: Total Expense Ratio (TER) is the collective operating cost of running and managing a mutual fund scheme — investment management fees, administrative, marketing, registrar, custodian and audit costs — expressed as a percentage of the fund's average net assets. The daily NAV is disclosed after deducting these expenses, so a lower TER means more of the return is retained by investors.

The Riskometer is a risk-measuring tool that depicts the risk level of a mutual fund scheme across six levels — Low, Low to Moderate, Moderate, Moderately High, High and Very High — each colour-coded. SEBI mandates asset management companies to display the Riskometer for their schemes.

An ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) is a mutual fund for tax savings under Section 80C, investing at least 80% of the corpus in equity and equity-related instruments. It has a 3-year lock-in period, the shortest among Section 80C tax-saving options, and allows tax deductions of up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per year.
source_name: SEBI Investor - A Guide to ELSS

text: To download a Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) from HDFC Mutual Fund: open the Download/Consolidated Account Statement page, enter your PAN or folio number, request an OTP, choose the financial year, and submit to receive the statement by email. There is no charge or fee for receiving or downloading your account statement.
source_name: HDFC Mutual Fund - Consolidated Account Statement

topic: how to download capital gains statement
text: A capital gains statement can be obtained via the AMC website or via the registrars (RTAs) CAMS and KFintech: log in with your PAN and registered email, request a consolidated capital gains report, select the financial year, and receive it by email. Statements are typically available after the financial year ends (post-March) for ITR filing.
source_name: HDFC Mutual Fund - How to get a capital gains statement
